name: HTV silicone rubber housing (PDMS/ATH composite)
description: HTV silicone rubber housing (PDMS/ATH composite) named on a page read in the Alaska GEG WBS sweep.

specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024) clause 3.1.2 table of characteristic composition; all silicone rubber insulators to be manufactured by HTV method. (value: approx. 37% silicone polymer (PDMS) and 10% silica; filler ATH and fumed silica )
